headline: Playa del Carmen Will Levy Sanitation Right on Vacation Rentals in 2027
summary: Playa del Carmen plans to charge a sanitation levy on vacation rentals starting in 2027. The proposal still needs ratification by the Quintana Roo state congress before the legislative year closes.
why: Short-term vacation rentals are a major part of tourism revenue in Quintana Roo, Mexico's Caribbean coast. New local levies affect rental operators and tourism-dependent property markets.
original_headline: Playa del Carmen gravará con derecho de saneamiento a rentas vacacionales en 2027
